what: Hut 8 runs large computing sites. It began as a bitcoin miner and is now converting and building capacity for artificial-intelligence computing, where customers pay to lease power and space. It also holds an interest in American Bitcoin, a separate mining venture.
customers: On the mining side, no customers: the company earns bitcoin by running machines. On the data centre side, AI computing companies leasing power, space and in some cases graphics processors.
money: Bitcoin earned from running mining machines, worth whatever bitcoin is worth.
Hosting and leasing capacity to AI computing customers, plus managed services.
moat: Contracted electrical power with approved grid connections is genuinely scarce, and Hut 8 controls sites with it. Obtaining a large interconnection agreement takes years, which is why existing power positions have become the valuable part of these companies rather than the mining machines themselves.
risks: The trailing twelve months show a net loss of about $518.6M and free cash flow of roughly negative $1.4B. The company is spending vastly more than it earns.
Cash of $44.9M against $428.0M of debt is very thin for that rate of capital spending, so further financing is certain and likely dilutive.
The shares trade at about 22 times sales, pricing in data centre contracts that are not yet all signed.
Bitcoin's price and the mining difficulty adjustment determine mining revenue, and neither is controllable.
Twenty-three analysts average a $127.70 target against a $55.80 price. A gap that large on a cash-burning business reflects speculation about future contracts, not a reliable estimate.
opportunities: Converting power capacity from mining to AI computing raises the revenue per megawatt substantially and makes it contracted rather than variable.
Revenue grew from $96.0M in 2023 to $235.1M in 2025, and the mix is shifting toward higher-value computing.
Demand for AI computing capacity currently exceeds available power, which favours anyone holding interconnection rights.
Each signed long-term lease converts speculative value into contracted cash flow, which markets reward immediately.
watch: Signed AI data centre leases and megawatts energised. Mining results are noise; the only thing that justifies the current valuation is converting power capacity into long-term contracts, and the pace of that is measurable.
